faction.abyss-town.abyss.name: Abyss
hero.abyss-town.abiss.biography: Abiss wandered for many years with her Crabs through the isles. She learned how to get the best use out of their claws through countless battles.
hero.abyss-town.abiss.name: Abiss
hero.abyss-town.abiss.specialty.descript: Increases Speed of any Sand Crabs or Abyssal Crabs by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up)
hero.abyss-town.abiss.specialty.name: Crabs
hero.abyss-town.abyssKarnTi.biography: When human mages first contacted Abyss towns, Karn-Ti was one of first scholars to study spellcraft. Now he is most respected Merrow in the deep oceans due to his foreign contacts and unique insight.
hero.abyss-town.abyssKarnTi.name: Karn-Ti
hero.abyss-town.abyssKarnTi.specialty.de: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Sorcery skill.
hero.abyss-town.arkana.biography: Arkana were born an undine. At young age she was enslaved by Yuan-Ti. But her natural talents impressed her master, so she was freed and at the age of twelve she was taken to an Abyssal Temple, where she learned magic.
hero.abyss-town.arkana.name: Arkana
hero.abyss-town.arkana.specialty.descrip: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Scouting skill.
hero.abyss-town.arkana.specialty.name: Scouting
hero.abyss-town.asler.biography: Asler lived an ordinary life until she came across a golden seahorse. From that day, she has searched the oceans for these mysterious beings, finding their preservation her reason to live.
hero.abyss-town.asler.name: Asler
hero.abyss-town.asler.specialty.descript: Can upgrade Magic Seahorse to Golden Seahorse
hero.abyss-town.asler.specialty.name: Golden Seahorses
hero.abyss-town.dissanna.biography: Dissanna had a simple upbringing but a Wizard noticed her knack for controlling flames, and taught her the ability to make mines with that power. Today, there are few who wishes to confront her directly on the battlefield.
hero.abyss-town.dissanna.name: Dissanna
hero.abyss-town.dissanna.specialty.descr: Casts Cure with increased effect, based on hero level.
hero.abyss-town.dissanna.specialty.name: Cure
hero.abyss-town.gril.biography: Gril was a gypsy with the strange power who was anathematized by other people. One stormy day she made the lighting fork on her behalf. Due to her state as a pariah, the kingdoms beneath sought quickly to hire her, as such power would be devastating in enemy hands.
hero.abyss-town.gril.name: Gril
hero.abyss-town.gril.specialty.descripti: Casts Chain Lightning with increased effect, based on hero level.
hero.abyss-town.gril.specialty.name: Chain Lightning
hero.abyss-town.kasta.biography: Kasta's wealth borders on the abundant. She is also quite the philantropist, helping those in need with a few extra gold pieces.
hero.abyss-town.kasta.name: Kasta
hero.abyss-town.kasta.specialty.descript: Increases kingdom's income by 350 gold per day.
hero.abyss-town.kasta.specialty.name: +350 Gold
hero.abyss-town.kingsax.biography: Little is known about Kingsax. He prefers remaining in the shadows, even hiding in a distance from his own battles, as the safety makes him think clearer.
hero.abyss-town.kingsax.name: Kingsax
hero.abyss-town.kingsax.specialty.descri: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Intelligence skill.
hero.abyss-town.kingsax.specialty.name: Intelligence
hero.abyss-town.kraken teamster.biograph: Kraas was born in solitude, and once he appeared before the king of the deep, self-nurtured and experienced, he was granted a position of power over his cephalopod relatives.
hero.abyss-town.kraken teamster.name: Kraas
hero.abyss-town.kraken teamster.specialt: Increases Speed of any Octopuses or Ferocious Octopuses by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up)
hero.abyss-town.pears.biography: Pears' helm of nautilus shell shards has held up after many, many years. It has proven to him more than enough that providing similar armor to his troops increase their longevity. He does argue with Trila over what is best, her expensive alloy or his natural shells.
hero.abyss-town.pears.name: Pears
hero.abyss-town.pears.specialty.descript: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Armorer skill.
hero.abyss-town.pears.specialty.name: Armorer
hero.abyss-town.perha.biography: Long ago, Perha found a mysterious diadem, whispering in her ears, providing her powers to twist the minds of others into madness.
hero.abyss-town.perha.name: Perha
hero.abyss-town.perha.specialty.descript: Bless Cure with increased effect, based on hero level.
hero.abyss-town.perha.specialty.name: Bless
hero.abyss-town.raytilii.biography: Raytilii found the jellyfish of the depths fascinating to no end. He would have them shoot at longer and longer distances every day just to see what the limit was. He also put them under many other tests as their ranged attacks would be most useful in a military campaign. One day, he did have one such campaign, and the results proved that these creatures were more than useful for the coming war.
hero.abyss-town.raytilii.name: Raytilii
hero.abyss-town.raytilii.specialty.descr: Increases Speed of any Aurelia or Storm Aurelias by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up)
hero.abyss-town.raytilii.specialty.name: Aurelia
hero.abyss-town.season.biography: Season was born underwater, and raised underwater like most of his brethren, deep in the coral forests in the depths. There, he honed his skills against any and all intruders and with age came experience. He soon became a teacher amongst his kin, and a proponent for bringing his skills to the test on the surface.
hero.abyss-town.season.name: Season
hero.abyss-town.season.specialty.descrip: Increases Speed of any Yuan-Ti or Yuan-Ti Warriors by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up)
hero.abyss-town.season.specialty.name: Yuan-Ti
hero.abyss-town.sirranna.biography: Sirrana is a bit of a pirate, talented in finding gems from the vessels she sinks. In her eyes, the proper term would be bandit, if you would settle with insults. She asks those who intrude on her waters to pay both in valuables and with their lives.
hero.abyss-town.sirranna.name: Sirranna
hero.abyss-town.sirranna.specialty.descr: Increases kingdom's income by 1 gem per day
hero.abyss-town.sirranna.specialty.name: +1 Gem
hero.abyss-town.trila.biography: For someone living underwater, Trila has a strange obsession with armor. She has found a special alloy that never rusts which she dresses her subjects in.
hero.abyss-town.trila.name: Trila
hero.abyss-town.trila.specialty.descript: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Offence skill percentage.
hero.abyss-town.trila.specialty.name: Offence
hero.abyss-town.verna.biography: Verna lived an ordinary life until she came across a Bloody Ornias. From that day, she has searched the oceans for these mysterious beings, finding their preservation her reason to live.
hero.abyss-town.verna.name: Verna
hero.abyss-town.verna.specialty.descript: Can upgrade Electric Ornias to Bloody Ornias
hero.abyss-town.verna.specialty.name: Bloody Ornias
hero.abyss-town.wel.biography: Wel was a mighty king of a small domain beneath the oceans. Seeing the deaths of countless of his subjects throughout the years, he sought magic to solve the issue of dwindling taxes. Eventually, he lost interest in ruling altogether, prefering the company of his tomes and the arcane arts, and always seek to aid those in need.
hero.abyss-town.wel.name: Wel
hero.abyss-town.wel.specialty.descriptio: Hero can cast the Resurrection spell with increased effectiveness
hero.abyss-town.wel.specialty.name: Resurrection
hero.abyss-town.werser.biography: Werser had excellent hearing, so great infact that he could hear the frequency on which seahorses speak. Werser thus developed a talent for speaking with the beasts.
hero.abyss-town.werser.name: Werser
hero.abyss-town.werser.specialty.descrip: Increases Speed of any Seahorses or Magic Seahorse by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up)
hero.abyss-town.werser.specialty.name: Seahorses
